item.title: How does Hopper distributed shared memory actually move data?
item.description:
NOTE: The benchmark and analysis code are available here.

As a computer architect, I always find an unexplained bandwidth number a bit annoying. While experimenting with the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) on Hopper, I started wondering: how much bandwidth can one SM actually get when accessing another SM’s shared memory?

Hopper allows thread blocks in the same cluster to communicate through distributed shared memory (DSM). From the programming model, this looks almost like ordinary shared memory with an extra CTA rank in the address. Underneath that abstraction, however, the access has to leave one SM, cross some on-chip network, reach another SM’s SRAM, and possibly return data or an acknowledgment. NVIDIA documents the programming model, but it does not publish a performance model for this path.

item.description:

When my friend described her team’s annual ritual of analyzing corporate ESG reports, I understood why she was desperate for change. item.title: Benchmarking GEMM on Modern CPU
item.description:
Recently I got interested to understand what’s the actual performance of GEMM on modern CPUs. We all understand that GEMM is the backbone for many critical applications and can never emphasize enough how important to optimize it. That being said, I never had a good first-hand experience on benchmarking GEMM on modern CPUs, and here I am.

We know that Intel has the famous MKL library that is mainly optimized for Intel’s CPU (of course), and there are open-sourced third party library such as OpenBLAS (come with numpy if you install using pip). However, what’s our choice for AMD architectures? It turns out they also have their own optimized library – AOCL (AMD Optmized CPU Library). And even better, AOCL is open-sourced (unlike MKL). Let’s start our journey now.

item.title: Bring AVX Support to Gem5
item.description:
TL;DR

gem5-avx brings partial AVX2 and AVX-512 support to gem5. Feel free to use it for your research at your own risk. There is a short guide on how to add new instructions at the end of this post. Issues and pull requests are welcome!

During my research this year, I had to implement AVX2 and AVX-512 in gem5, as I could not find a good online. Eventually I had a partial implementation which works for the workloads I looked into. Luckily, the paper gets published in this year’s HPCA, and I have already released the code for that project: gem-forge.

item.title: Extend RISC-V ISA with Matrix Multiply
item.description:
Many computer architecture students will eventually add some new (useless) instructions to a ISA, and there are many great tutorial on how to do this. This is yet another notes on my struggling to extend RISC-V with a new matrix multiply instruction. The overall goal is to add a new functional unit in a general purpose processor to do a 4x4 matrix multiply accumulate with single-precision floating-point.

The Manual has a very detailed explanation on what ISA encoding is reserved for such non-standard extension (see ch.21). Basially any instruction with a prefix (starting from LSB) 00 010 11 or 01 010 11 is reserved.

item.title: Setup This Website with Hugo
item.description:
After 2 years with my previous dummy personal website, I was urged to create a better one. After some googling, I made this tiny website using Hugo. Here are some notes for a n00b in front-end like me.

  • Make sure you download the extended version of Hugo. Otherwise you won’t have support for SASS and SCSS (I have no idea what these are). Just scroll down in the release page and you will find it.
  • Create a new post with hugo new posts/awesome-post.md.
  • After you created some post, make sure to modify the draft field to false. Otherwise you will get a 404 in blog and spend half an hour wondering why.
  • You can use icon from Font Awesome by <i class="fab fa-github"></i>. And always remember that you can embed HTML directly in the markdown. This is a nice workaround if you can not get what you want from markdown.
  • Use hugo server to start the server. It will automatically detect any changes in the folder and rerender the website.
  • This tutorial shows how to user Hugo with GitHub pages. Basically they are using git submodule.

I hope this is useful someday.

About Zhengrong Wang

I am currently an assistant professor at CSE Department, The Chinese University of Hong Kong. I am generally interested in developing high performance computer architecture for both general and domain specific computing with compiler support. I am also looking into how to accurately and efficiently model and simulate current architectures.

I obtained my Ph.D. from UCLA, working with Prof. Tony Nowatzki. Prior joining UCLA, I received Bachelor of Engineering from Department of Electronic Enginerring, Tsinghua University. I also studied at ETH Zürich for half a year as a exhange student.

Projects - No Research Just for Fun

Yart-Yet Another Ray Tracer

Yart is a simple but powerful ray tracer engine. It reads in a scene description file and parses it. Then it renders the scene and prints the output image. For objects, it supports sphere and triangle mesh. For material, Lambertian, Specular, Refraction and Cook-Torrance BSDF are implemented. To solve the light equation, it can use either direct lighting or bidirectional path tracing. To accelerate the computation, multiple threads and OC-Tree are used.

招生信息

我正在积极寻找有志于加入我实验室的博士生、硕士生、研究实习生和研究助理，开始时间为2026年夏季/秋季。如果您对计算机体系结构研究感兴趣，并有兴趣在香港中文大学进行前沿研究，请阅读以下指南。

关于我

我本科毕业于清华大学电子工程系，在加州大学洛杉矶分校(UCLA)计算机科学系获得博士学位，师从Tony Nowatzki教授。

关于我的研究

我的研究兴趣广泛涵盖体系结构、微体系结构、编译器以及支持下一代硬件上高需求应用的编程语言，研究成果主要发表在体系结构的顶级会议ISCA，MICRO，HPCA，ASPLOS上。随着技术缩放放缓，复杂应用（特别是大型语言模型）对计算系统提出了越来越高的要求，体系结构正转向针对不同场景定制的专用和异构系统。

作为计算机架构研究者，我们的作用不仅仅是设计新硬件——我们必须创建富有表现力的抽象，使丰富的语义能够在整个计算栈中高效传递，从而释放众多协同优化机会。这使我们的领域既关键又极具挑战性，也很有趣。

关于你

我的研究涵盖了多样化的技能和专业知识。理想情况下，你应该在以下一个或多个领域有经验：

  • 强大的编程技能：精通C、C++、Python等相关语言
  • 硬件仿真和建模：具有gem5、GPGPU-Sim或类似工具的经验
  • 编译器实现：熟悉LLVM、MLIR、clang、GCC或相关框架
  • 应用开发：在图处理、大型语言模型、计算机视觉或其他高需求应用方面有经验
  • 硬件设计和原型：了解Verilog、综合工具、FPGA开发或相关硬件设计经验

最重要的是，您应该对计算机体系结构研究有真正的热情。当我们深入研究我们的领域时，我们常常发现还有多少东西需要学习，但兴趣是最好的老师。同时，韧性和决心也很重要，因为研究道路很少平坦，需要在挑战中坚持不懈。

关于香港中文大学

香港中文大学(CUHK)是亚洲顶尖的研究型大学之一，享有全球声誉。学校坐落在山坡上，俯瞰吐露港，为研究和学习提供了鼓舞人心的环境。计算机科学与工程学系在国际上享有盛誉，拥有优秀的研究设施和计算基础设施。香港中文大学提供负担得起的校内住宿（单人间约每月4,000港币，需要抽签但中签概率不低）。香港的战略位置为整个亚洲的合作提供了绝佳机会，旁边就是香港科技园，方便去工业界实习获取一手经验。

  • 附上简历和学术成绩单

如果你在CUHK，欢迎在Office Hour（周三下午3-5点）来我办公室进行非正式讨论。

自我评估问题

为了帮助评估自己对计算机体系结构研究的准备程度和兴趣，我整理了一些我在面试中通常会探讨的基本问题。如果你能自信地回答大约70%的这些问题，我相信你对计算机体系结构有真正的热情。如果你发现自己在超过70%的问题上有困难，我可能不是非常合适。但也无所谓，就把这当作一次学习机会：）

编译器和编程系统

  • 程序是如何从源代码转换为二进制可执行文件的？这个过程中的关键阶段是什么？
  • 您能描述一些编译器优化技术并解释它们如何提高程序性能吗？

计算机体系结构

  • 什么是指令集架构(ISA)，为什么它很重要？
  • 解释经典的五级流水线及其在处理器设计中的目的。
  • 流水线处理器中可能发生哪些类型的冒险，通常如何解决？
  • 什么是内存一致性模型，为什么它们在多处理器系统中很重要？

性能建模和分析

  • 什么是屋顶线模型 (Roofline Model)，如何用它来分析应用程序性能？
  • 如何估计工作负载在给定系统上的性能？
  • 基于事件和基于周期的仿真有什么区别，什么时候使用哪种？

实践知识

  • 你的笔记本电脑、台式机或智能手机中的CPU/GPU型号是什么？它们的关键特性是什么？
  • 你经历过重大的硬件升级吗？您注意到了什么性能改进？
  • 你目前在日常生活或工作中如何使用AI？幕后发生了什么计算过程？

当代AI和计算

  • 大型语言模型推理中的预填充和解码阶段有什么区别？
  • 为什么DeepSeek被认为是AI领域的突破？从系统角度来看，是什么让它如此特别？

Description

Computer architecture is the glue that binds the worlds of hardware and software. Developing new architectures is the art and science of understanding the intrinsic properties of applications, developing and interconnecting hardware components to meet cost and performance goals, and creating abstractions that enable efficient use of hardware without sacrificing generality.

item.title: Running Qwen3-8B on DGX Spark
item.description:
My DGX Spark recently arrived! That’s some 40k HKD I hope well spent :)

I wanted to play with deploying a small LLM locally. I picked Qwen3-8B and tried BF16, FP8, NVFP4, SGLang, vLLM, and DSpark. This post is just a record of the numbers.

Summary

All servers use a 32,768-token context limit and CUDA Graph. SGLang uses FlashInfer; vLLM uses its V2 runner, compiled kernels, and full plus piecewise CUDA Graph. Memory figures below are model-weight footprints reported by the server or checkpoint sizes, not total system memory usage.
